goal: Turn the current-exact MNP procedure master into a problem-solving diagnosis engine that maps user-selected contract/flow/account states to provider-specific blockers and next actions without inventing unsupported account status.
diagnosis_dimensions: SIM/eSIM reissue or transfer in progress
key_results: Only current_exact/current-scope-limited provider records enter the diagnosis engine.
Explicitly ineligible contract types can return a hard stop; unknown/not-assumed eligibility returns verification, not denial.
MNP One-Stop and reservation-number flows remain separate and provider-specific.
Provider blocker strings are normalized into shared diagnosis taxonomy while retaining the original evidence text.
Issue timing and reissue/cancellation information are surfaced separately from blocker diagnosis.
LinksMate real-account observation remains visually and structurally separate from official provider rules.
J:COM source-side outbound unknowns remain unknown rather than inferred.
next_step: Phase175: currentize only the highest-value remaining legacy MNP providers where official evidence materially improves the diagnosis engine, rather than indiscriminately updating all 49 long-tail services. Prioritize distinctive blockers and GSC/search demand.
